## Data Visualizations

### Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)     
library(here)   
library(ggplot2)      
library(dplyr)     
library(viridis)    
library(showtext)
library(openxlsx)
```

### Data Load-In

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: true

# Read in budburst data
budburst <- read_csv(here('data/data/budburst_est_2015.csv'))

# Read in vine cold-hardiness data
vines_cold <- read_csv(here('data/VineColdHardiness.csv'))

# Read in grape production data
# **Will change to revenue % for better representation of popularity**
ca_wine <- read.xlsx(here('data/california_without_raisin_and_table_grapes.xlsx'), sheet = "Area by V (ha)")

# Read in projected bb data
climate_future <- read_csv(here('data/ZDavis_data_4climatefuture.csv'),  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Read in projected bb data
phases <- read_csv(here('data/dat_4phases_noNA_2015.csv'), show_col_types = FALSE)

leafout <- read_csv(here('data/data/leafout_est_2015.csv'))
```

### Data cleaning

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false

# Clean production data
colnames(ca_wine) <- gsub("^area", "", colnames(ca_wine))

ca_wine_long <- ca_wine %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -variety, names_to = "year", values_to = "area_ha") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(area_ha), year >= 2000) %>%
  mutate(area_rank = factor(dense_rank(desc(area_ha))))

#### Go back and use janitor and possibly combine different datasets into one main set
```

### Heatmap

```{r}
#| warning: false

# Set font
font_add_google(name = "Cormorant Garamond", family = "cormorant")
showtext_auto()

# Heatmap of variety popularity (vineyard area) by year
ggplot(ca_wine_long, aes(x = factor(year), y = variety, fill = area_ha)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", width = 0.9, height = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Area (ha)") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Vineyard Area by Variety and Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Variety") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12,
                base_family = "cormorant") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
                                  size = 14, 
                                  hjust = 0.5, 
                                  margin = margin(b = 8)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank())

```

### Phenological Events Plot

```{r}
#| warning: false

# make a vector of 5 varieties
popular_varietals <- phases %>%
  distinct(variety) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 5) %>%
  pull(variety)

# Make a basic dot plot 
ggplot(
  phases %>% 
    filter(variety %in% popular_varietals),
  aes(x = variety, y = doy.2015, color = event)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_discrete(
    labels = c(bb = "bud burst",
               brix22 = "ripen",
               flo  = "flowering",
               ver = "verasion")) +
  labs(title = "Phenological Events for 5 British Columbia Varieties (2015)",
       x = "Variety",
       y = "Day of Year") +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  theme_minimal(base_family = "cormorant") +
  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
                                  size = 14, 
                                  hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10))

```


### Lethal Cold Temperature (LTE) Plot

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# calculate the mean lte for each variety in each year
mean_lte_summary <- vines_cold %>%
  group_by(variety, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_lte = mean(lte, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

top_reds <- c("Merlot", "Pinot noir", "Cabernet Sauvignon", "Cabernet Franc", "Shiraz")

top_whites <- c("Pinot gris", "Chardonnay", "Riesling", "Gewurztraminer", "Sauvignon blanc")

mean_lte_summary %>% 
  filter(variety %in% top_reds) %>%
  mutate(year = factor(year)) %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_lte, y = variety, color = year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.1),) +
  
  labs(title = "Mean Lethal Temperature by Red Variety",
       x = "Lethal Temperature (°C)",
       y = "Variety",
       color = "Year") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_family = "cormorant")

mean_lte_summary %>% 
  filter(variety %in% top_whites) %>%
  mutate(year = factor(year)) %>%  
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_lte, y = variety, color = year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.1),) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Lethal Temperature by White Variety",
    x = "Lethal Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Variety",
    color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "cormorant")

```
